convert_siglip2_checkpoint: convert a Siglip2 checkpoint from the original repository to HuggingFace format
get_siglip2_config: create a Siglip2Config from a model name string with variant and patch size
get_siglip2_tokenizer: create a Siglip2Tokenizer loaded from the Gemma checkpoint with right padding
get_siglip2_image_processor: create a Siglip2ImageProcessorFast with specified patch size and normalization settings
verify_siglip2_logits: verify converted model logits match expected outputs against the original implementation
